title: GHSL AI agent helps find command injection in Weaviate notifier workflow
summary: Unsanitized issue-title input reached a script in Weaviate notifier.yml, which ran on user-triggered events with sensitive secrets and repository permissions.
ai_role: GHSL explicitly credits its AI agent and CodeQL jointly; their individual contributions are not specified. Reported 2025-08-11; the maintainer confirmed and removed the susceptible workflow that day. No CVE is listed.
classification_note: The advisory describes potential code execution and secret exposure; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: The maintainer removed the susceptible workflow on 2025-08-11. No replacement version or CVE is specified.

impacts.conditions: Attacker-controlled notifier data reaches Weaviate workflow command; GHSL advisory describes command injection.
impacts.exploitation: The cited source does not establish exploitation in the wild.
